sections.text:
> Не править руками: это генерируемый вид.

| ID | Date | Status | Items | Решение |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| D1 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10 | Все новые security, durability, API/package и release-hardening работы принадлежат отдельному PLAN1 `2026.09.19-№1-AGENTOOLS-HARDENING`. Существующий `AGENTOOLS` остаётся неизменным историческим evidence source; его фазы и P11 не переоткрываются. |
| D2 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10 | Lifecycle имеет три последовательные стадии: отдельный `task:plan-design` для каждой P1–P10; после последней — независимый `task:plan-audit <ID> design`; только после GREEN design audit — `task:plan-exec` item'ов. Наличие готового item до завершения стадии 2 не разрешает его исполнение. |
| D3 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10 | На `high` detail P1/P2/P6/P7/P9/P10 выполняет `gpt-5.6-sol`; P3/P4/P5/P8 — Grok 4.6. Все проходы используют repository recon и широкий внешний retrieval. Perplexity предпочтителен, когда connector доступен, но каждый load-bearing external claim подтверждается primary source. |
| D4 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P9, P10 | PLAN1 обязан собрать и принять production-grade local/private PHP/Dart release candidate. Public registry upload, git tag/release, credential use и смена license/legal identity запрещены до явного `[OWNER-GATE:G-RELEASE]` с утверждёнными artifact digests и publication channel. |
| D5 | 2026-09-19 | proposed | P10 | Предлагается сначала принять private/local release candidate, а public Packagist/pub.dev/GitHub release рассматривать только после отдельного owner-решения о license, vendor/package identity, support channel и exact registries. |
| D6 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P1, P1.1, P1.2, P1.3, P1.4, P1.5 | P1 состоит из machine-readable clean-worktree baseline и четырёх versioned contract layers: trust/threat, compatibility/migration, guarantees/non-guarantees и resource/benchmark. Baseline RED не чинится в P1 и не считается regression. Reachable PHP/Dart symbols не считаются stable API до P7, а support не заявляется без именного green carrier. |
| D7 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P2, P2.1, P2.2, P2.3, P2.4 | P2 вводит `ConfirmationService` как единственную поддерживаемую application boundary. На одном вызове caller передаёт только intent/actual arguments либо token/actual arguments; actor, time, descriptor, policy, proposal/approval evidence, authorization context и separation/quorum получаются из доверенных constructor dependencies. `ConfirmationProtocol` сохраняется временно как deprecated expert/legacy primitive для совместимости и focused tests, но reference consumers не вправе вызывать его напрямую. Полный binding tuple фиксируется логически в P2. P3 выбирает token/durable representation, P5 — journal storage, P6 — новую shared spec/error revision, P7 — final exports/removal. Frozen `spec/revisions/2026-08/**` в P2 не изменяется. |
| D8 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P3, P3.1, P3.2, P3.3, P3.4 | P3 использует компактный собственный envelope `at1.` + canonical JSON + HMAC-SHA256, а не JWT как требование. Подпись покрывает `v`, `alg`, `kid`, `iss`, `aud`, `jti`, `tenant_id`, `purpose` и существующие CNF-15 поля. `TokenKeyProvider` разделяет ключи по tenant и purpose со состояниями `active` / `verify_only` / `compromised` / `retired`. Одноразовость — свойство предъявления (CNF-20): после integrity/time/P2-binding атомарный `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING` пишет `(tenant_id, jti)` с `outcome=presented`. Пустой RETURNING есть spent. Отказ authorization не оживляет token. Pre-presentation ошибки store не пишут. Production adapter принимает внедрённый PDO (PHP) или SQL executor (Dart); новых Composer/pub runtime-библиотек нет; `ext-pdo_pgsql` — suggest. In-memory store только testkit. Versioned SQL поставляется артефактом пакета; PLAN1 не выполняет live migration чужой базы, owner-gate на P3 items не требуется. Frozen `spec/revisions/2026-08/**` не изменяется. Старый двухсегментный token без `at1.` после cutover отклоняется. |
| D9 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P4, P4.1, P4.2, P4.3, P4.4 | P4 заменяет поддерживаемый idempotency port на `acquire` / `heartbeat` / `complete(lease)` / `fail(lease)`. Наблюдаемые состояния остаются IDE-10 (`new`, `duplicate_completed`, `concurrent_in_flight`). Внутренний ряд — `in_progress` (lease token + `lease_until` + `attempt`) или `completed` (сохранённый успех или ошибка). `fail` пишет `completed` с ошибкой; четвёртого observer-состояния и retry того же ключа после доменного отказа нет (IDE-13). Каждый acquire/takeover выдаёт новый opaque fencing token и монотонный `attempt`. Heartbeat, complete и fail — CAS по текущему token; пустой `RETURNING` есть `idempotency_lost_lease`. Lease duration независим от record retention и confirmation lifetime. Cleanup удаляет только completed-истёкшие ряды; in-progress молча не удаляется. Takeover после `lease_until <= now` допускается на уровне store. Повторный вызов инструмента решает `IdempotencyCoordinator` по `ToolIdempotencyCapability` (`native_key` / `read_before_write` / `compensatable` / `at_most_once_only` / `unknown`). Unknown + high-risk (`side_effect` не `read`/`draft`) отклоняется до INSERT. Outbox/inbox и saga не встраиваются. Lease fence не сливается с ALC epoch (ALC-28; epoch — P5). Production adapter принимает внедрённый PDO/SQL, как D8; новых Composer/pub runtime-библиотек нет. In-memory только testkit. Versioned SQL — артефакт пакета; live migration чужой базы не выполняется. Frozen `spec/revisions/2026-08/**` не изменяется. Unfenced `complete(request)` на supported path отклоняется. |
| D10 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P5, P5.1, P5.2, P5.3, P5.4 | P5 заменяет поддерживаемый journal port на `EventStore.append(stream, expectedPrevSeq, UncommittedEvent[])` и paginated `load`. Stream identity — `(tenant_id, action_id)`. Пустой журнал — `expected_prev_seq = 0`; хранилище назначает непрерывный `seq` с 1 и store-wide `global_position` (`GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY`). `ExpectedVersion.Any` не существует. Батч непустой, максимум 64, атомарный: все события или ни одного. Идемпотентный retry — тот же набор `event_id` в том же порядке с тем же content hash как уже записанный суффикс при исходном expected version. Тот же `event_id` с другим hash — `event_id_collision`. Частичное пересечение батча — `event_batch_partial_overlap`, не дописывание. Content hash — RFC 8785 по uncommitted envelope **без** `seq` / `expected_prev_seq` / `prev_hash` / `global_position`. `event_id` задаёт вызывающий (UUID/ULID), не `ev-{action}-{seq}`. `audit.*` остаётся в том же журнале (AOB-1). Export `AuditSink` — optional redacted derived adapter; отказ экспортёра не откатывает append (AOB-18). Payload allow/deny — AOB-14/16. Метки метрик — закрытый low-cardinality набор; `tenant_id` / `action_id` / `event_id` / `trace_id` запрещены. OpenTelemetry SDK в runtime dependencies нет. Снапшот несёт `seq`, `spec_rev` и content hash события на этом `seq`; при расхождении отбрасывается. Журнал не усекается (ALC-32..34). ALC epoch не сливается с P4 lease token и не выводится из `event_id` (ALC-28, D9). Production adapter — injected PDO/SQL, как D8/D9. In-memory только testkit. Frozen `spec/revisions/2026-08/**` не изменяется. Single-event `EventLog.append(ActionEvent)` на supported path отклоняется. |
| D11 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P6, P6.1, P6.2, P6.3, P6.4, P6.5 | P6 creates self-contained candidate revision `2026-09` and its corpus without changing frozen `2026-08`. Normative Markdown, schemas and case manifests remain owners; one deterministic `semantic-manifest.json` is generated from them with source digests. PHP and Dart keep handwritten DTOs/constants under DR-02 and expose actual semantic profiles for exact-set comparison. P6 does not generate SDK source. JCS is proven against RFC 8785 and the Apache-2.0 upstream oracle corpus pinned at commit `19d51d7fe467d4706a3ff08adf8a748f29fc21e0`, including the first 10,000 deterministic ES6-number rows. One SDK never generates the other's expected bytes. Official MCP evidence uses exact dev-only pin `@modelcontextprotocol/conformance@0.2.0-alpha.11` and its npm integrity. Every `2026-07-28` requirement row is classified, but only scenarios reachable through the public `agentools_mcp_dart` client boundary execute as applicable. This repository ships no MCP server and no PHP MCP transport. The result is named “official MCP scenario compatibility”, never certification, Tier 1 or full client/server conformance. Agentools conformance and official MCP reports stay separate. P6 commits a candidate revision lock, not a public git tag. Publication/tagging remains behind G-RELEASE in P9/P10. |
| D12 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P7, P7.1, P7.2, P7.3, P7.4 | P7 defines one normative package-boundary policy and one exact machine-readable target roster for PHP core, Dart core/testkit and the Dart MCP companion. Reachability is candidate inventory, not a stability promise. A stable entry requires intentional export/autoload classification, a production consumer and behavioural proof; missing or extra actual entries fail the gate. PHP remains one production Composer package by default. `AgenTools\\Reference\\` and `AgenTools\\TestKit\\` are root-only development contours and are excluded from the production archive. Process-local in-memory/fixed implementations are testkit, never production defaults. Stable current FQNs remain compatible; an accidental candidate may move only with a recorded P1 compatibility disposition. Dart core remains one package with two intentional libraries: `agentools.dart` for supported core and `agentools_testkit.dart` for test doubles. `lib/src` is implementation and external imports are unsupported and linted, but it is not described as technically inaccessible. `agentools_mcp_dart` stays a separate optional package and imports only supported core libraries. No public registry or hosted dependency is selected in P7. The companion’s path dependency is tested only as a paired private artifact and stays an explicit P9/P10 public-release blocker. Every P7 artifact claim is proved from actual archives and disposable consumers; publication remains behind D4/D5/G-RELEASE. |
| D13 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P8, P8.1, P8.2, P8.3, P8.4, P8.5 | P8 introduces one normative adversarial-verification contract and exact `AV-###` manifest. Every critical P1–P7 guarantee is bound to its upstream owner, independent oracle, finite workload tier, named property/mutant/schedule/resource proofs and digest-qualified receipt. P8 cannot change an upstream semantic contract to make a failing proof green; a confirmed defect returns to its exact owner through the plan repair/readiness protocol. Generated property/fuzz evidence is language-neutral and deterministic. Reproduction identity includes PRNG/generator/corpus/manifest versions and digests, seed, case index, runtime environment and input digest. Minimized failures are promoted to immutable regressions; neither SDK is allowed to rewrite expected data from its own output. Mutation evidence is intentionally asymmetric. PHP uses scoped, locked Infection with fresh coverage/JUnit evidence, calibrated MSI/covered-MSI floors and timeouts treated as escaped. PHP and Dart both must kill the same applicable curated critical semantic mutant catalog. Dart mutants are exact digest-bound patches in a disposable tree; a generic regex/text mutation percentage is not called equivalent to Infection or used as a release claim. Invalid, unapplied, skipped, timed-out or harness-error mutants are non-green. PostgreSQL durability/concurrency evidence uses separate worker processes/connections, explicit controller barriers and observed backend/blocker state. SQLite, in-memory stores, sleeps or a single process do not close PostgreSQL rows. Client crash, query cancel and backend termination are separate fault classes; server/power-loss WAL certification and exactly-once external effects remain excluded. Resource evidence separates portable bounds/growth/resource ceilings from host-bound timing. Timing can block only against a reviewed baseline with matching environment and workload fingerprint; otherwise it is informational or `baseline_pending`. PHP and Dart speed is never compared. P8 defines workload tiers and receipts; P9 alone maps them to CI, and P10 accepts the release candidate. |
| D14 | 2026-09-19 | accepted | P9, P9.1, P9.2, P9.3, P9.4, P9.5 | P9 has two non-crossing trust planes. Untrusted PR/change CI receives no secrets or write token, does not execute fork code under privileged events and cannot feed caches/artifacts into trusted release assembly. Trusted private RC consumes only frozen repository-owned inputs. Every workflow starts with `permissions: {}`, grants per-job minimums and pins every third-party action by reviewed full commit SHA; CLI tools/images are checksum/digest locked. P8 proof tiers are mapped exactly: focused/required bounded on PR, bounded on main, extended on schedule/manual and release-candidate only in trusted private RC. PHP/Dart supported versions come from P1; lowest/latest resolutions run in disposable copies and never supply candidate locks. Canonical release subjects are repository-owned normalized tar+gzip archives for PHP, Dart core and the private-paired Dart MCP companion. P7 manifests define selected contents; P9 fixes order, metadata and compression and requires byte-identical independent clean builds. Native package commands remain content/validity oracles and do not define deterministic registry bytes. SPDX 2.3 JSON is the single normative SBOM format. Source/lock and extracted-subject inventories stay separate and are reconciled. SLSA v1.2 provenance binds exact archive digests and materials. Current unified `actions/attest` is used only at a reviewed full SHA and only when private-repository capability is positively proved. Local verified provenance is not called an attestation; unavailable, disabled, unknown and not-executed hosted states remain distinct. Workflow artifact identity is transport evidence, never release-file identity. P9 builds and verifies a private candidate only. It does not change GitHub settings, publish registries, create a tag/release, settle license/public identity or use publication credentials; D5/P10/G-RELEASE retain those decisions. |
| D15 | 2026-09-20 | accepted | P10, P10.1, P10.2, P10.3, P10.4, P10.5 | P10 uses one exact claim/evidence matrix and two non-collapsing verdict axes. Private readiness may be GREEN only when one exact P9 candidate, its docs, clean consumers, migrations and all required P1–P9 evidence are current with zero unresolved private blocker. Public eligibility is evaluated separately and is never authorization. P10 accepts only the local/private candidate and emits a digest-bound G-RELEASE decision request. The request names exact proposed legal/package identities, channels, version/tag, subject digests, actions, credential/capability prerequisites, consequences and invalidation triggers. It contains no owner grant and performs no tag, GitHub release, registry upload, credential use or repository-setting mutation. Any future public action is separate owner-authorized scope and must bind the exact packet digest through `[OWNER-GATE:G-RELEASE]`. D5 remains owner-owned and unsuperseded. While D5, public identities/channels, `publish_to: none`, the Dart MCP path dependency or required platform capability remain unresolved, public eligibility is false without making a technically valid private acceptance red. |
| D16 | 2026-09-20 | accepted | P0.1, P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10 | Future product execution uses 19 adjacent `task:plan-run` batches rather than 23 separate sessions. P2.1–P2.4 become `confirmation`, P3.1–P3.4 `token-replay`, P4.1–P4.4 `lease-fencing`, and P5.1–P5.4 `event-store`. These four phases are linear contract-to-gate contours whose Required Reads, source graph and validation setup remain useful through the final item. Every item retains its own lifecycle, validation and closure inside the group. One Cursor launch model is fixed for every batch. `Composer 2.5/high` owns synthesis-heavy API, semantic, packaging, CI and release batches in P1/P2/P6/P7/P9/P10. `Grok 4.6/high` owns crypto/replay, fencing, event persistence and adversarial verification batches in P3/P4/P5/P8. No batch changes model mid-session. P7.4, P8.4, P8.5, P9.5 and P10.5 remain `solo`: respectively clean artifact isolation, destructive test-only PostgreSQL safety, post-evidence calibration, independent aggregate re-hash, and final authority separation are stronger boundaries than the saved cold start. |
| D17 | 2026-09-21 | accepted | P0.1 | Разрешить одну точную `journal-migration/v1` для PLAN1. Миграция обязана сохранить исходные bytes `@plan/log.jsonl`, зафиксировать SHA-256 каждой изменённой строки и всего preimage/target, а также оставить постоянный manifest и receipt в `journal-migrations/2026-09-21-p0.1-repair/`. Допустимы только нейтральный backfill пропущенных sealed-полей и точное восстановление `terminal-evidence/v1`. Миграция не может менять `ts`, item identity, command, attempt, result, actor и note; не может трогать product code, historical `AGENTOOLS`, release verdict или G-RELEASE authority. |
